flood.meaning: P(site lies in a FEMA Special Flood Hazard Area)

fire.meaning: P(site lies inside a >=100-acre fire perimeter from 2005-2018)

solar.meaning: Terrain and high-voltage-grid similarity to existing US utility-scale solar plants (not economics, irradiance, land price or permitting)
solar.caveat: Experimental: held-out AUC 0.68 across states, but 0.63 in Ohio (only 26 test sites). In flat farmland, terrain and grid distance barely separate solar sites from neighbouring fields, so treat it as a rough screen.
